coordinate_system: Model origin; X right; Y up (-model Y); top view for every layer; bottom files are not mirrored
exclusions: Scoped geometry export, not fabrication readiness or clearance/continuity certification
No legacy previews, inner copper, pours, arcs, plated component through holes/slots, blind/buried/microvias, paste, silkscreen, netlist/X3 assembly or material/finish/stackup instructions
Mask expansion is an export parameter; all vias untented; no manufacturer rules inferred
Circular nonplated holes use explicit component geometry on both sides; absent hole policy is uninspected intent. No slots, drill suitability, material or manufacturer verification.
